hypothesis: Niacin or NAD+ repletion raises steady-state BUBR1-N1002K and lowers PCS and missegregation in patient cells
endpoint: BUBR1 western blot (vs cycloheximide chase), K668 acetylation, PCS rate, live-cell mitotic timing
counter: Wu 2023 (38009412): SIRT2 overexpression does not extend lifespan in wild-type mice, so the benefit may be specific to low-BubR1 states (which applies here). The niacin -> BUBR1 link is not tested directly. Nicotinamide, NR and NMN are supplements, not approved drugs.

hypothesis: Low-dose rapalog lowers SASP and senescence in patient fibroblasts without lowering BUBR1 or raising missegregation
endpoint: pS6, SA-beta-gal, SASP panel, BUBR1 level, karyotype
counter: mTOR inhibition induces autophagy, and autophagy degrades BubR1 in senescent cells (37094517), so it might lower BUBR1 further. Immunosuppression during cancer therapy.

hypothesis: D(+Q) selectively removes senescent patient fibroblasts without enriching aneuploid proliferating cells
endpoint: SA-beta-gal/p16 clearance; interphase FISH aneuploidy of survivors
counter: Healthspan but not lifespan benefit; it does not address the tumour risk and might remove a tumour-suppressive barrier.

branch: A/B: block autophagic BUBR1 loss; aneuploidy-selective
hypothesis: HCQ raises BUBR1 in patient cells under stress and preferentially reduces aneuploid-cell fitness
endpoint: LC3-II flux, BUBR1 level, FISH aneuploidy fraction over passages
counter: MVA mutant BUBR1 is cleared by the proteasome, not shown to go through autophagy. Killing aneuploid cells in a mosaic child could harm tissues, an untested risk.

hypothesis: Arimoclomol increases BUBR1-N1002K half-life in patient cells in an HSF1-dependent manner
endpoint: Cycloheximide-chase half-life with or without drug; HSP70 induction; PCS rate
counter: No evidence links HSP70 induction to BUBR1. Boosting chaperones could help tumour cells too.

hypothesis: 4-PBA raises BUBR1-N1002K abundance without changing K668 acetylation
counter: No BUBR1 data at all. HDAC-inhibitor effects on mitosis are a confounder.

hypothesis: Metformin reduces the aneuploid fraction in long-term patient fibroblast culture
endpoint: Interphase FISH over passages; growth curves
counter: Metformin is not AICAR, and AMPK-mediated selection is only shown for trisomies. Failure to thrive argues against an anorexigenic drug.

hypothesis: Patient cells show an ISG signature that JAK inhibition reverses without raising aneuploid-cell survival
counter: cGAS-STING-driven immune clearance of CIN cells may be protective (28738408). Direction unknown.
